That is evidence against a no-retracement path, and it offsets the fact that opening-auction structure is not yet visible.

headline: NQ futures near 30,214.25 retrace about 129 points from the 30,343.00 post-Empire-State high as the cash open passes, with the VIX at 15.07, the 10-year near 4.71% and WTI near $82.80
body:
NQ futures were 30,214.25 on a 13:19Z delayed quote, up about 72.5 points or 0.24% on the 30,141.75 prior settlement, inside an observed session band of roughly 30,182.00-30,343.00. The defining structural fact of this hour is that the contract has retraced approximately 129 points from that session high, which was set in the wake of the 12:30Z Empire State release. An hour earlier the same contract was quoted at 30,256.25 and closer to the top of its range.

That retracement is the most consequential evidence available. The August Empire State Manufacturing Survey printed a general business conditions index of 20.6 against a consensus near 11 and a prior of 15.6, its highest reading in more than four years, with new orders at 17.3 and prices paid up six points to 58.6. A hot print of that size is exactly the configuration in which a persistent no-retracement path would establish itself if one were forming. Instead the observed post-release path shows price discovery working in both directions, with NQ giving back a meaningful share of its post-print gain rather than holding near its extreme. Under the governing risk definition this argues for keeping Tail inside the low band, and it is why Tail holds at 16 rather than extending higher into the cash open.

Cross-asset corroboration remains genuinely two-sided rather than aligned. Delayed context shows NQ near +0.44% while Dow futures are near -0.21% and S&P futures near +0.11%, a dispersion that is inconsistent with a single efficient directional regime. Treasury futures across the 2-year to 30-year curve are effectively unchanged, with the 10-year yield near 4.71% and the 2-year near 4.18%. The VIX at 15.07 is up about 5.7% on a 14.25 prior close but is confined to a 14.89-15.08 range, which is a repricing of level rather than an expansion of realised volatility. Latest-session sector detail shows semiconductors and semiconductor equipment firmly positive, led by Micron above $1,000, against negative application and infrastructure software, and megacap breadth of five positive to three negative with dispersion of only 0.64 points. Internal rotation of that shape supports mean reversion more than it supports index-level trend.

The session's narrative driver is AI capital expenditure. Reported Anthropic revenue growth to more than $11.5 billion in the second quarter, against $787 million a year earlier, has supported the view that datacentre spending is durable, and memory and storage names have led on that basis. A related and slower theme is that heavy technology issuance is estimated to have added roughly 0.3 percentage points to the 10-year yield this year. Both are valuation drivers on a multi-week horizon rather than mechanisms capable of producing an hourly no-retracement path.

Geopolitics remains the principal unresolved discontinuity risk rather than an active path driver. Transit through the Strait of Hormuz has slowed sharply, with five commodity vessels recorded on Saturday and none on Sunday against 31 the previous weekend, and US-Iran talks remain stalled. Crude's contained response, with WTI near $82.80 and Brent near $89.04, indicates the market is not pricing a physical supply outage, so this is scored into Stress and into headline gap risk rather than into the current Tail path.

The narrow danger window spans 13:30Z to 15:00Z, covering the opening auction, the first full cash hour and the 14:00Z NAHB release. Opening-auction structure is the one mechanism that has historically preceded mean-reversion failure from an already aligned bullish regime, and it is not yet observable. Absent evidence of shallow pullbacks or repeated extension after failed retracements in that interval, Tail remains well below the blocking threshold and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON. The remainder of the week carries FOMC minutes on Wednesday and a heavy retail earnings slate from Home Depot, Target, Lowe's and Walmart, which are scheduled checkpoints rather than current path risks.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment. Tail stayed inside the low band for the entire window, ranging from 12 to 17, with the mapped policy state EA_ON throughout. Stress peaked at 82 during Sunday's US-hours window while Gulf conflict and crude headlines dominated, then decayed steadily to 66 by the final hour as the tape compressed. Confidence improved from 77 to 84, with a temporary dip to 68 across the thin Sunday evening hours, as live futures pricing, volatility, rates and calendar evidence became progressively better corroborated. Dominant mode was mixed through the active sessions and normal across the quiet overnight stretch. At no point in the window was a persistent no-retracement path observed, and the final two hours captured the Empire State release and the orderly two-way repricing that followed it.
outlookSummary: The conditional path keeps Tail inside the low band across all 24 forecast hours, with the mapped policy state EA_ON throughout. Conditional risk holds at 16 in the current hour containing the cash open, peaks at 18 across the 14:00Z hour covering the first full cash hour and the NAHB release, which is the point at which opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would first become observable, then eases to 17 as opening imbalances clear. It decays through the US afternoon to 14, lifts to 16 into the 19:00Z power hour where late-session flow can be directionally efficient, and falls to a window minimum of 12 across the thin post-close and Asian hours. It rebuilds gradually through the European session on Tuesday and returns to 16 in the final slot immediately ahead of the 12:30Z Housing Starts and Building Permits releases. Stress eases from 65 to a low of 55 overnight before rebuilding to 63, and Confidence decays from 84 to 68 with forecast distance, which reflects horizon rather than any weakness in the current evidence base.
